content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the klaipeda district court the defendant has been ordered to pay legal fees and court fees as well as stamp duty the court has decided to dissolve the marriage and divide the matrimonial property the defendant was awarded certain items and a car while the applicant was awarded a cutlery set and a car the defendant was also ordered to pay compensation for a greater share of movable property the court considered two articles from the civil code related to property the applicant is seeking the dissolution of the marriage division of property establishment of residence and contact arrangements for their child and maintenance payments the defendant has submitted a statement of defense proposing their own division of property and access to the child the court has accepted some of the applicants requests and ordered the defendant to pay certain costs the court has decided to dissolve the marriage and awarded specific items and a car to each party the defendant was also ordered to pay compensation and stamp duty
